To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the IC analysis shows that the simultaneous retrieval of greenhouse gases (CO2 and CH4) from multispectral TANSO- FT measurements is more accurate than using the measurements from a single band, and that the retrieval accuracy is similar for a selected number of channels in TIR and SWIR.

the use of multispectral information from TANOS-FTS allows retrieving CO2 with a precision of 1 ppmv and CH4 with a precision of about 0.5 ppmv, and that the use of the multispectral information allows a significant reduction of the computation time.
the multispectral synergy can improve the retrieval accuracy and reduce the computation time for the retrieval of greenhouse gas concentration.
